description: Update issue. 'set_labels' replaces the issue's whole label set; use add_issue_labels or remove_issue_labels to change it incrementally

assignee.description: Assignee username (convenience for a single user; equivalent to a one-element 'assignees')

assignees.description: Assignee usernames (comma-separated). Overrides 'assignee' if both are set. Pass an empty string to clear all assignees.

clear_due_date.description: Clear the issue's due date. Mutually exclusive with 'due_date'.

due_date.description: Set the issue's due date (RFC3339, e.g. 2026-08-20T00:00:00Z). Mutually exclusive with 'clear_due_date'; setting both is an error.

ref.description: The branch this issue is linked to (Forgejo's issue 'ref' field, distinct from a pull request link). Passed to Forgejo as given; Forgejo decides which forms it accepts. Omit to leave it unchanged; pass an empty string to clear it.

set_labels.description: Replace the issue's entire label set (comma-separated). Accepts label names or numeric IDs. A name is matched before an ID, so a label named "123" wins over the ID 123. An unrecognised name is an error and nothing is applied; list_repo_labels shows what exists. Pass an empty string to remove every label. To add or drop individual labels without restating the set, use add_issue_labels or remove_issue_labels.

verbose.description: Return the full entity instead of the compact summary (number, url, title, state, labels, assignees, updated_at). Default false.

name: update_issue
